brief: RCA (2026-10-20, recurrence 2): two update_pr.sh runs on one branch share the fixed worktree $HPO_STATE_DIR/pr/upd-<branch> and its log; each force-removes the worktree at start (update_pr.sh:35), so the second deletes the first's live worktree mid-prepr. The concurrent run is cloud_relay.sh pass's handoff arm (cloud_relay.sh:199-200), which auto-updates any PR whose handoff is ahead, racing a manual update. Fix: an exclusive per-branch lock taken before any fetch or worktree change (BUSY exit 75, released by the kernel on death), and the relay treats 75 as retry-next-pass, not failure. Controls: an offline two-run reproduction, pr_args/update_pr self-test BUSY check plus a stale-lock null, cloud_relay self-test, mutation.
